title.narrative: Reinforcing the collaboration for a better response to HIV and TB in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Mozambique, TB/HIV, Fundação para o Desenvolvimento da Comunidade (FDC)This program has the following goals: Reduce by 50% the number of new HIV infections by 2017 against the 2013 estimates. Reduce the mortality from HIV in TB patients (by HTC and provison of early ART to all). Reduce the mortality from TB in HIV infected persons (by ICF and early TB treatment to all with TB). The objectives of this program are: Increase awareness, distribute and promote consistent use of condoms and lubricants. Increase targeted HIV testing for the general population, pregnant women, and key populations. Outreach key populations with comprehensive HIV/TB package of services (Female sex workers, migrant population, MSM, Youth and Adolescents)
